name: Naradriel
source: Princess Naradriel of Fallinel is Tracker's ex. Enough said. And she just happens to be leaving Fallinel for Solace at the same time as Tracker. Something about learning Solesian customs from Elmville residents to improve Fallinelven-Solesian relations?
